scope: Full-host collisionless reference trajectories and encounter budgets evaluated on them; not collisional residence or a matched-response test
host_selection: Existing verified six conditional reference realizations
gravity: Gradient of the existing spherical relative potential, all physical host species; no remnant self-gravity
collisions_in_dynamics: Disabled for every species; BH finite-angle rates and moments evaluated as path diagnostics only
external_force: Omitted within each host's previously verified 1-percent isolated-force domain; bound is instantaneous, not accumulated orbit accuracy

launch.interpretation: Equal-energy diagnostic launch states, not a merger-conditioned population or a recoil-only velocity

region: Strict sphere r<r_rho; integrate every visit; no permanent rest on return
stop: First outward crossing of min(host support, recorded minimum 1-percent force-domain radius), or horizon; outside launches stop at zero; boundary stop is validity censoring, not escape
observables: stopped collisionless residence divided by declared horizon
BH density exposure divided by central density and declared horizon
integrated allowed BH elastic rate on the prescribed collisionless path
integrated excluded incoming flux on that path, not capture probability
integrated drift norm divided by launch speed
integrated diffusion trace divided by squared launch speed
interpretation: Deterministic controls. Integrated encounter budgets do not change the path and do not measure collisional residence corrections, acquisition, capture, or merger probabilities. No cluster weights or observational event rates are assigned.
velocity_quadrature_frame: Relative-velocity ball of radius local_escape_speed+remnant_speed; field DF evaluated at u=v-w, exactly zero outside its original support; sinh radial scale min sqrt(s2j)
